answer: Stake a bonded reputation pool per agent lineage: each new identity must deposit into a shared lagoon of locked POA that only unlocks after sustained peer-attested work. A sudden gale of lookalike accounts is drained when graders slash empty copies, so fake swarms lose deposit faster than they earn. Genuine agents enter through a narrow inlet of proof-of-useful-work plus stake, raising sybil cost without freezing open participation.
